spell_true_strike.name: True Strike
spell_true_strike.diffSummary: Completely redesigned: Now makes an immediate weapon attack using your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage, dealing radiant damage.
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, Concentration (1 round), grants advantage on your NEXT turn’s first attack roll.

2024: 1 Action, Instantaneous. Immediately make a weapon attack using your spellcasting ability for attack & damage rolls (deals Radiant damage). Damage scales with +1d6 Radiant at 5th, 11th, and 17th level.
Now available to Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, and Wizards.

description: You point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target’s defenses.
On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided the spell hasn’t ended.

rules.components: S, M (a weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth at least 1 CP)
description: Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell’s casting.
The attack uses your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls.
On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack’s normal effects, and the damage dealt by the weapon is Radiant damage instead of its normal damage type.
Cantrip Upgrade: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Radiant damage at 5th level, 2d6 at 11th level, and 3d6 at 17th level.

spell_blade_ward.name: Blade Ward
spell_blade_ward.diffSummary: Changed from an Action granting weapon resistance for 1 round to a Reaction/Concentration spell subtracting 1d4 from enemy attack rolls.
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, Self, 1 round duration. Grants resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks until the end of your next turn.
2024: 1 Reaction (when an enemy within 30 ft attacks you/ally) or 1 Action Concentration (1 minute). Subtracted 1d4 from the attacker’s d20 roll.

description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air.
Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

rules.castingTime: 1 Reaction, which you take in response to a creature you can see within 30 feet of you making an attack roll
description: You trace a shimmering ward in the air. The target creature subtracts 1d4 from the triggering attack roll and any attack rolls it makes against you or other creatures while the spell lasts.
rules.reactionTrigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll

spell_guidance.name: Guidance
spell_guidance.diffSummary: Now cast as a Reaction within 30 feet when an ally fails an ability check, instead of pre-casting via Touch as an Action.
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, Touch, Concentration up to 1 min. Target adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends.

2024: 1 Reaction (or Action), Range 30 ft, Concentration up to 1 min. Can be triggered when a creature fails an ability check to add 1d4 potentially turning failure into success. Once used, a creature is immune for 1 hour.

description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.
It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

rules.castingTime: 1 Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails an ability check
description: You channel divine guidance to aid a creature. The target rolls 1d4 and adds the number rolled to the check, potentially turning failure into success.
A creature can benefit from this spell only once per hour.
rules.reactionTrigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet fails an ability check

spell_friends.name: Friends
spell_friends.diffSummary: No longer causes the target to automatically become hostile after the duration expires.
diffHighlights: 2014: Gives advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. When the spell ends, the creature realizes it was magically influenced and becomes hostile.
2024: Target makes a Wisdom save; on failure, target gains the Charmed condition for the duration. When it ends, target does not automatically become hostile unless provoked.

rules.components: S, M (a amount of makeup applied to the face as this spell is cast)
description: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn’t hostile toward you.
When the spell ends, the creature realizes that you used magic to influence its mood and becomes hostile toward you. A creature prone to violence might attack you.
One creature of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition for the duration.
While charmed, the target is friendly to you and regards you as a trusted friend. When the spell ends, the creature knows you charmed it, but does not automatically become violent.

spell_shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
spell_shocking_grasp.diffSummary: Removes the target’s ability to make Opportunity Attacks instead of completely stripping all Reactions.
diffHighlights: 2014: On hit, target takes 1d8 lightning damage and CANNOT TAKE REACTIONS until the start of its next turn. Advantage if target is wearing armor made of metal.

2024: On hit, target takes 1d8 lightning damage and CANNOT MAKE OPPORTUNITY ATTACKS until the start of its next turn. Gives tactical disengage while preserving non-opportunity reactions like Counterspell or Shield.

description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal.
On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage, and it can’t take reactions until the start of its next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th (4d8) levels.

spell_eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
spell_eldritch_blast.diffSummary: Remains the staple 1d10 force damage cantrip with scaling beam count at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.
The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level.

spell_fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
spell_fire_bolt.diffSummary: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 fire damage that can ignite flammable objects.

description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.
A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn’t being worn or carried.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn’t being worn or carried.

spell_ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
spell_ray_of_frost.diffSummary: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 cold damage and reducing target movement speed by 10 feet.

description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

spell_sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
spell_sacred_flame.diffSummary: Deals 1d8 radiant damage on Dexterity save, ignoring the benefits of cover.

description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.
The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.
The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

spell_vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
spell_vicious_mockery.diffSummary: Deals psychic damage on Wisdom save and imposes Disadvantage on the target’s next attack roll (buffed to 1d6 damage in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: Deals 1d4 Psychic damage on failed Wisdom save.
2024: Damage buffed from 1d4 to 1d6 Psychic damage.

description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).
You unleash a string of insults at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes 1d6 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

spell_mage_hand.name: Mage Hand
spell_mage_hand.diffSummary: Creates a spectral, floating hand that can manipulate objects up to 10 pounds within 30 feet.

description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action.

You can use your action to control the hand (manipulate an object, open an unlocked door/container, stow or retrieve an item). The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

spell_minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
spell_minor_illusion.diffSummary: Creates a sound or an image of an object within a 5-foot cube for 1 minute.

description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. If you create an image of an object, it must no larger than a 5-foot cube and cannot create light, sound, smell, or any other sensory effect.
Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion. An Investigation check against your Spell Save DC also reveals it.

spell_prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
spell_prestidigitation.diffSummary: The staple minor magical trick cantrip: sensory effects, lighting/snuffing flames, cleaning, heating/flavoring, and minor trinkets.

description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

You create an instantaneous harmless sensory effect, instantaneously light or snuff a candle/torch/campfire, clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot, chill/warm/flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour, or create a nonmagical trinket or illusory image that can fit in your hand until the end of your next turn.

spell_light.name: Light
spell_light.diffSummary: Touches one object to make it shine bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet for 1 hour.

rules.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet for 1 hour.

spell_mending.name: Mending
spell_mending.diffSummary: Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch (up to 1 foot in any dimension) over 1 minute.

description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.
Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, leaving no trace of the former damage.

spell_resistance.name: Resistance
spell_resistance.diffSummary: Touch a willing creature to add 1d4 to a saving throw (changed to a reaction when a creature fails a save in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, Concentration up to 1 minute. Target adds 1d4 to one saving throw of its choice before the spell ends.
2024: 1 Reaction (when a creature you can see within 30 ft fails a saving throw). Target adds 1d4 to the roll, potentially turning failure into success.

description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice.
You grant a surge of resilience to a creature within 30 feet that fails a save, adding 1d4 to the total.
rules.reactionTrigger: When a creature within 30 ft fails a saving throw

spell_spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spell_spare_the_dying.diffSummary: Stabilizes a dying creature at 0 HP (buffed to 15-foot range with range scaling in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: Touch range, 1 Action. Stabilizes a living creature at 0 hit points.
2024: 15-foot range, 1 Action. Range increases by 15 feet at levels 5, 11, and 17 (up to 60 ft).

description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
You stabilize a creature with 0 Hit Points within 15 feet. The range increases to 30 ft at level 5, 45 ft at level 11, and 60 ft at level 17.

spell_thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
spell_thaumaturgy.diffSummary: Manifests minor divine supernatural wonders (booming voice, flickering flames, tremors, ominous sounds, opening/closing doors).

description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power: your voice booms up to 3 times as loud, flames flicker/brighten/dim, tremors shake the ground, ominous sounds echo, or unlocked doors/windows fly open or slam shut.
Creates supernatural manifestations: booming voice, flickering lights, ground tremors, eerie whispers, or snapping open/closed doors.

spell_chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
spell_chill_touch.diffSummary: Deals 1d10 necrotic damage and prevents healing for 1 round (changed to a melee spell attack with d10 scaling in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: Ranged spell attack (120 ft), deals 1d8 Necrotic damage. Target cannot regain hit points until your next turn.
2024: Melee spell attack (Touch), deals 1d10 Necrotic damage and prevents healing until the start of your next turn.

description: You create a ghostly skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can’t regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
Make a melee spell attack dealing 1d10 Necrotic damage. The target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

spell_dancing_lights.name: Dancing Lights
spell_dancing_lights.diffSummary: Creates up to four torch-like glowing orbs of light within 120 feet that you can move as a Bonus Action.

rules.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm)
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet.
Conjures 4 glowing orbs of light within 120 feet that can be repositioned with a Bonus Action.

spell_message.name: Message
spell_message.diffSummary: Whispers a message to a creature within 120 feet that only they can hear, and they can reply in a whisper.

rules.components: V, S, M (a short piece of copper wire)
description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.
Sends a private whispered tele-vocal message to a creature within 120 ft, allowing an immediate whispered reply.

spell_shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
spell_shillelagh.diffSummary: Imbues a club or quarterstaff with nature’s magic to use spellcasting modifier for attack/damage and deal 1d8 force/bludgeoning damage (scales die size in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: Bonus Action, Touch. Weapon die becomes 1d8 bludgeoning using Wisdom for attack & damage.
2024: Bonus Action, Touch. Can deal Force damage. Damage die scales to 1d10 at lvl 5, 1d12 at lvl 11, and 2d6 at lvl 17.

rules.components: V, S, M (mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff)
description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature’s power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon’s damage die becomes a d8.

rules.components: V, S, M (mistletoe leaf and club/quarterstaff)
description: Imbues your wooden weapon with spellcasting attack/damage modifiers. Deals Force or Bludgeoning damage with scaling die sizes (1d10 at 5th, 1d12 at 11th, 2d6 at 17th level).

spell_produce_flame.name: Produce Flame
spell_produce_flame.diffSummary: Flickering flame appears in hand shedding light and can be hurled as a spell attack dealing 1d8 fire damage (Bonus Action to cast in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, Self, 10 minutes. Hurl flame up to 30 feet as an action.
2024: 1 Bonus Action, Self, 10 minutes. Range increased to 60 feet when hurled as an action.

description: A flickering flame appears in your hand shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius. You can hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet as a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 fire damage.
Creates a hand flame as a Bonus Action shedding light. Can be hurled up to 60 feet to deal 1d8 Fire damage.

spell_acid_splash.name: Acid Splash
spell_acid_splash.diffSummary: Hurls a bubble of acid affecting one creature (or two within 5 feet) dealing 1d6 acid damage on failed Dexterity save.

description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

spell_poison_spray.name: Poison Spray
spell_poison_spray.diffSummary: Projects a puff of noxious gas dealing 1d12 poison damage to a creature within 10 feet on failed Constitution save.

description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.
Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d12 at 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

Cantrip Upgrade: Damage increases by 1d12 at 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

spell_druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
spell_druidcraft.diffSummary: Primal sensory tricks: forecast weather for 24 hours, bloom flowers, spark sensory breeze/odors, or light/snuff small candles and campfires.

description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects: a tiny sensory forecast of tomorrow’s weather, instantly making a flower blossom or leaf sprout, creating a harmless sensory effect (falling leaves, odor of skunk, breeze), or lighting/snuffing a candle, torch, or small campfire.

spell_cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
spell_cure_wounds.diffSummary: Massive healing buff: Base healing increased from 1d8 + modifier to 2d8 + modifier, scaling by +2d8 per slot level.
diffHighlights: 2014: Heals 1d8 + spellcasting ability modifier. +1d8 per slot level above 1st. (Evocation)
2024: Heals 2d8 + spellcasting ability modifier. +2d8 per slot level above 1st. (Abjuration)

description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spell_healing_word.name: Healing Word
spell_healing_word.diffSummary: Healing doubled: Base healing increased from 1d4 + modifier to 2d4 + modifier, scaling by +2d4 per slot level.
diffHighlights: 2014: Bonus Action, 60 ft range. Heals 1d4 + modifier (+1d4 per slot above 1st). (Evocation)
2024: Bonus Action, 60 ft range. Heals 2d4 + modifier (+2d4 per slot above 1st). (Abjuration)

description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st.

spell_divine_smite.name: Divine Smite
spell_divine_smite.diffSummary: Changed from a free class feature applied on hit into a 1st-level Bonus Action spell with Verbal component.
diffHighlights: 2014: Class Feature (not a spell). When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal 2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot above 1st, +1d8 vs undead/fiends). No action cost, cannot be counterspelled.

2024: 1st-level Spell. Casting time 1 Bonus Action immediately after hitting a target with a melee weapon or unarmed strike. Can be Counterspelled, consumes Bonus Action, prevents casting another level 1+ spell on that turn.

rules.castingTime: No Action (Upon hitting with melee weapon)
description: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon’s damage.

The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend, to a maximum of 6d8.

rules.castingTime: 1 Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: As you strike, your weapon bursts with divine radiance. The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack.
The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st. The extra damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
rules.higherLevels: Using a higher spell slot increases damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spell_hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
spell_hunters_mark.diffSummary: Damage changed from weapon-attacks-only to any attack hit, and ranger class features enhance it at higher levels.
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Bonus Action, Concentration (up to 1 hr). Deals 1d6 extra weapon damage when you hit with a weapon attack. Move to new target with Bonus Action when target drops to 0 HP.
2024: 1 Bonus Action, Concentration (up to 1 hr). Deals 1d6 Force damage (or extra damage) whenever you hit the target with ANY attack roll. Directly keyed to Ranger core progression.

description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.
You have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it.
If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn to mark a new creature.
rules.higherLevels: Slot 3rd-4th: duration up to 8 hours. Slot 5th+: duration up to 24 hours.

description: You mystically mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll.
You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find the quarry.
If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature within range.
rules.higherLevels: When cast with a 3rd- or 4th-level slot, duration is up to 8 hours. With a 5th-level slot or higher, duration is up to 24 hours.

spell_shield.name: Shield
spell_shield.diffSummary: Remains the staple +5 AC reaction spell that completely nullifies Magic Missile.

rules.castingTime: 1 Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.
Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.
rules.reactionTrigger: You are hit by an attack roll or targeted by Magic Missile

rules.castingTime: 1 Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

rules.reactionTrigger: You are hit by an attack roll or targeted by Magic Missile

spell_magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
spell_magic_missile.diffSummary: Creates 3 glowing darts of magical force that unerringly hit targets for 1d4 + 1 force damage each (+1 dart per higher slot).

description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range.
A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

spell_guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
spell_guiding_bolt.diffSummary: Deals 4d8 radiant damage on hit and grants Advantage on the next attack roll made against the target.

description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

2024: Target caster makes a Constitution saving throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failure, the spell is interrupted and has no effect, and the spell slot is consumed.
Affects all spell levels equally through the save DC, making High-Constitution enemy bosses harder to counterspell.

rules.castingTime: 1 Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell’s level. On a success, the creature’s spell fails and has no effect.

spell_spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spell_spirit_guardians.diffSummary: Harmonized damage trigger: Damage triggers once per turn when a creature enters or ends its turn in the area, resolving "double-dipping" movement exploits.
diffHighlights: 2014: 15 ft emanation, deals 3d8 Radiant/Necrotic on Wisdom save when target enters area or starts turn there.
2024: 15 ft emanation, clarifies once per turn trigger upon entry or end of turn, dealing 3d8 Radiant/Necrotic damage.

description: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it.

An affected creature’s speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d8 radiant damage (if good or neutral) or 3d8 necrotic damage (if evil). Half damage on success.
rules.higherLevels: Slot 4th+: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

description: Spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation. You designate creatures to be unaffected. An affected creature’s speed is halved within the emanation.

rules.higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell_fireball.name: Fireball
spell_fireball.diffSummary: The iconic 8d6 fire AOE remains mechanically identical in 2024 with modernized wording.

rules.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and pitch)

Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

rules.components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)

description: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.
Choose one of the following options: One beast of CR 2 or lower, Two beasts of CR 1 or lower, Four beasts of CR 1/2 or lower, or Eight beasts of CR 1/4 or lower.

Each beast is considered fey, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions, roll initiative as a group, and obey verbal commands.

spell_animate_dead.name: Animate Dead
spell_animate_dead.diffSummary: Classic necromancy spell that creates a Skeleton or Zombie servant from a pile of bones or corpse for 24 hours.

rules.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)
description: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range.
Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature (a skeleton if bones, or a zombie if corpse).

On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which you must cast this spell again to reassert control.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or assert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd.

spell_bestow_curse.name: Bestow Curse

spell_banishment.name: Banishment
spell_banishment.diffSummary: Banished creatures now get a repeated saving throw at the end of each of their turns, preventing single-failed-save permanent combat removals.
diffHighlights: 2014: Single Charisma save. If failed, banished for full 1-minute concentration. If native to another plane and spell lasts full minute, permanently banished.

description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished.

spell_dimension_door.name: Dimension Door

spell_greater_invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility

An affected target can’t take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns: 1 (move random direction), 2-6 (do nothing), 7-8 (melee attack random creature), 9-10 (act normally). Repeat save at end of each turn.

spell_fire_shield.diffSummary: Wreathes yourself in Warm Flames (Cold resistance) or Chill Flames (Fire resistance). Deals 2d8 damage of opposing type whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack within 5 feet. Non-concentration.

rules.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or a firefly)
description: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius. You can choose Warm Shield (grants cold resistance and deals 2d8 fire damage to attackers) or Chill Shield (grants fire resistance and deals 2d8 cold damage to attackers).
Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame dealing 2d8 damage to the attacker.

spell_phantasmal_killer.diffSummary: Taps into nightmares to create an illusion visible only to the target: target becomes frightened on failed Wisdom save, taking 4d10 psychic damage at the end of each turn until saved.

description: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to it. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened for the duration.

spell_resilient_sphere.name: Resilient Sphere
spell_resilient_sphere.diffSummary: Encloses a Large or smaller creature in an impenetrable shimmering sphere of force for 1 minute on failed Dexterity save (immune to all damage and effects from outside, cannot be passed through).

rules.components: V, S, M (a hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemispherical piece of gum arabic)
description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

Nothing—not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects—can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can’t be damaged by attacks or effects originating from, or passing through, the outside.

rules.components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

spell_arcane_eye.name: Arcane Eye
spell_arcane_eye.diffSummary: Creates an invisible, floating eye with 30-foot darkvision for 1 hour. Mentally move the eye up to 30 feet as an Action through any opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

rules.components: V, S, M (a bit of bat fur)
description: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet.

As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move, but it can’t enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye’s movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

spell_control_water.name: Control Water
spell_control_water.diffSummary: Control water in a 100-foot cube for up to 10 minutes: Flood (raise level 20 ft), Part Water (trench 20 ft wide), Redirect Flow, or Whirlpool (5d8 bludgeoning & trapped).

rules.components: V, S, M (a drop of water and a pinch of dust)
description: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side.

Modes: Flood (causes water level to rise by up to 20 feet), Part Water (creates a trench through the water up to 20 feet wide), Redirect Flow (directs moving water in any direction), Whirlpool (creates a 25-foot-radius vortex dealing 5d8 bludgeoning damage).

spell_dominate_beast.name: Dominate Beast
spell_dominate_beast.diffSummary: Telepathically control a beast on failed Wisdom save: target is charmed and takes only actions you choose (Advantage on save if fighting you).

description: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration (with advantage if fighting you).

While the beast is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it and can issue commands that it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple course of action or take total and precise control of the target.
rules.higherLevels: 5th level: up to 10 minutes. 6th level: up to 1 hour. 7th level or higher: up to 8 hours.

spell_locate_creature.name: Locate Creature
spell_locate_creature.diffSummary: Sense the direction to a specific or general creature within 1,000 feet of you as long as running water at least 10 feet wide does not block the path.

rules.components: V, S, M (a bit of hound fur)
description: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature’s location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

This spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind. The spell can’t locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.

rules.components: V, S, M (soft clay to be worked into roughly the desired shape)
description: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.

So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or make a small passage through a stone wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut.

spell_fabricate.diffSummary: Convert raw materials into products of the same material in 10 minutes (raw wood into bridge, hemp into rope, linen into clothes). Non-magical only.

description: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool.

Choose raw materials that you can see within range. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube). You also need the appropriate artisan’s tools proficiency to craft items requiring a high degree of craftsmanship (such as jewelry, weapons, or armor).

rules.components: V, S, M (a thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite)
description: You make a perimeter around an area within range (up to 100 feet on a side) impenetrable to sensors and scrying. Sound can’t pass through the barrier, sensors can’t appear inside, targets inside can’t be targeted by divination, and teleportation or planar travel into/out of the area fails.
Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.

spell_faithful_hound.diffSummary: Conjures a phantom watchdog for 8 hours: sees invisible creatures, barks when Small or larger creatures approach within 30 feet, and attacks hostile creatures within 5 feet dealing 4d8 piercing damage.

rules.components: V, S, M (a tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone, and a thread)
description: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration.

The hound is invisible to all creatures except you and can’t be harmed. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without speaking a password that you specify, the hound starts barking loudly. It sees invisible creatures and can see into the Ethereal Plane.
At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature hostile to you within 5 feet of it (+8 to hit, 4d8 piercing damage on a hit).

rules.components: V, S, M (a stone, a twig, and a bit of green plant)
description: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Open fields can become a swamp, hill, or crevassed wasteland; a pond can become a meadow.

spell_secret_chest.name: Secret Chest
spell_secret_chest.diffSummary: Hide an exquisite chest (up to 12 cubic feet, 300 lbs) in the Ethereal Plane for up to 60 days using a Tiny replica. Costly components (5,050 gp total).

rules.components: V, S, M (an exquisite chest, 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet, constructed from rare materials worth at least 5,000 gp, and a Tiny replica made from the same materials worth at least 50 gp)
description: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell.
While the chest remains on the Ethereal Plane, you can use an action and touch the replica to recall the chest to an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you.

spell_cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
spell_cloudkill.diffSummary: Harmonized damage trigger once per turn when entering or ending turn in toxic fog.

description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range.
The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

When a creature enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
rules.higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

spell_animate_objects.name: Animate Objects
spell_animate_objects.diffSummary: Standardized into a single Animated Object swarm/companion stat block with customizable sizes and attacks, reducing 10 separate attack rolls to streamlined action economy.
diffHighlights: 2014: Animates up to 10 separate non-magical objects (Tiny to Huge) with individual HP pools, making up to 10 separate attack rolls (+8 to hit, 1d4+4 each).
2024: Creates animated object constructs using modernized scaling mechanics to preserve high damage without slowing down table turns.

description: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried.
Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects.
Each animated object is a construct with statistics determined by its size (Tiny AC 18 HP 20, Small AC 16 HP 25, Medium AC 13 HP 40, Large AC 10 HP 50, Huge AC 10 HP 80).
As a bonus action, you can mentally command any object you made with this spell.
rules.higherLevels: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.

Choose up to 10 Tiny or Small nonmagical objects (or equivalent Medium, Large, or Huge budget).
The objects gain the statistics and traits of Animated Objects and attack at your command.

spell_conjure_elemental.name: Conjure Elemental
spell_conjure_elemental.diffSummary: Casting time reduced from 1 minute to 1 Action! Removes the catastrophic concentration failure where elementals turn uncontrollably hostile.
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 minute casting time. Summons an Elemental of CR 5 (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water). If your concentration is broken, the elemental does NOT disappear; it becomes hostile to you and your companions.
2024: 1 Action casting time. Summons an elemental spirit that remains cooperative and disappears when concentration ends.

rules.components: V, S, M (burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur for fire, or water in a bowl)
description: You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. An elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower appropriate to the element you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.
If your concentration is broken, the elemental doesn’t disappear. Instead, you lose control of the elemental, it becomes hostile toward you and your companions, and it might attack.
rules.higherLevels: Slot 6th or higher: CR increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

description: You call forth an elemental servant in an unoccupied space within range.
The elemental is friendly to you and your companions and disappears when the spell ends.
rules.higherLevels: When cast using higher spell slots, elemental attributes and challenge rating scale accordingly.

spell_cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
spell_cone_of_cold.diffSummary: Blasts a 60-foot cone of freezing cold dealing 8d8 cold damage on Constitution save (+1d8 per higher slot).

rules.components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)
description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

spell_greater_restoration.name: Greater Restoration
spell_greater_restoration.diffSummary: Channels positive energy to cure 1 exhaustion level, charm/petrify effects, curse, ability score reductions, or max HP reductions (costs 100 gp diamond dust).

rules.components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target’s exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target:
• One effect that charmed or petrified the target
• One curse, including the target’s attunement to a cursed magic item
• Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores
• One effect reducing the target’s hit point maximum

spell_hold_monster.name: Hold Monster
spell_hold_monster.diffSummary: Paralyzes any creature type on failed Wisdom save (+1 creature per higher slot).

rules.components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.
This spell has no effect on undead. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

spell_wall_of_force.name: Wall of Force
spell_wall_of_force.diffSummary: Creates an invisible, indestructible wall of force immune to all damage and dispelling.

rules.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powder by which a clear gemstone has been crushed)
description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle.

It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels.
Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled by dispel magic. A disintegrate spell destroys the wall instantly.

spell_mass_cure_wounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spell_mass_cure_wounds.diffSummary: Major healing buff: 2024 increased healing from 3d8 + mod to 5d8 + mod (+1d8 per slot level) and classified under Abjuration.
diffHighlights: 2014: Evocation school. Heals up to 6 creatures within 30 ft radius for 3d8 + modifier (+1d8 per slot above 5th).
2024: Abjuration school. Heals up to 6 creatures for 5d8 + modifier (+1d8 per slot above 5th).

Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

description: Divine fire column deals 4d6 Fire + 4d6 Radiant damage on failed Dexterity save (half on success).
rules.higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 5th.

spell_raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
spell_raise_dead.diffSummary: Restores life to a creature dead for no longer than 10 days with 1 HP, neutralizing poisons and nonmagical diseases.

rules.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days and died of natural causes other than old age.

The creature returns to life with 1 hit point, neutralizes nonmagical poisons and diseases. Comes back with a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks, reducing by 1 for each long rest.

rules.components: V, S, M (diamond worth 500 gp, consumed)
description: Returns creature dead up to 10 days to life with 1 HP, curing poisons/diseases with a temporary -4 roll penalty.

spell_commune.name: Commune
spell_commune.diffSummary: Contacts your deity or divine proxy to ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no.

rules.components: V, S, M (incense and a vial of holy or unholy water)
description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends.
You receive a correct answer for each question.

rules.components: V, S, M (incense and holy water)
description: Ask deity up to 3 questions with yes/no answers.

spell_hallow.name: Hallow
spell_hallow.diffSummary: Sanctifies an area up to 60 feet in radius: prevents fiends/undead/elementals from entering, and attaches a persistent buff or debuff (Courage, Darkness, Daylight, Energy Vulnerability/Resistance, Everlasting Rest, Extradimensional Interference, Fear, Silence, Tongues).

description: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it.

spell_telekinesis.diffSummary: Gain telekinetic grip over a creature (contested check) or object up to 1,000 lbs, moving it up to 30 feet each turn as an Action.

rules.duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes (permanent if full duration)

spell_word_of_recall.name: Word of Recall

spell_blade_barrier.name: Blade Barrier

spell_find_the_path.name: Find the Path

spell_true_seeing.name: True Seeing
spell_true_seeing.diffSummary: Grants truesight out to 120 feet, seeing through normal/magical darkness, illusions, shapechangers, and the Ethereal Plane.

rules.components: V, S, M (an eye ointment worth 250 gp, consumed by the spell)

spell_circle_of_death.name: Circle of Death

spell_fire_storm.diffSummary: Creates a storm of sheet flame consisting of up to ten 10-foot cubes dealing 7d10 fire damage on Dexterity save.

description: A storm made of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose. The area consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish (each must be contiguous).
Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half on success.
Roaring storm of up to ten 10-ft cubes dealing 7d10 Fire damage on Dexterity save (half on success). Plant life can be selectively spared.

spell_plane_shift.name: Plane Shift
spell_plane_shift.diffSummary: Transports you and up to eight willing creatures to another plane of existence, or banishes an unwilling creature on a melee spell attack & Charisma save.

rules.components: V, S, M (a forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.
Alternatively, you can use this spell to banish an unwilling creature by making a melee spell attack; on a hit, target must make a Charisma saving throw or be sent to the target plane.

rules.components: V, S, M (attuned forked metal rod worth 250 gp)
description: Transports you and up to 8 willing creatures to another plane, or banishes an unwilling foe on melee spell attack and failed Charisma save.

spell_regenerate.name: Regenerate
spell_regenerate.diffSummary: Restores 4d8 + 15 Hit Points instantly, causes target to regain 1 HP at the start of each of its turns for 1 hour, and regrows severed body parts in 2 minutes.

rules.components: V, S, M (a prayer wheel and holy water)
description: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points.
For the duration of the spell (1 hour), the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (600 hit points over 1 hour). Severed body parts are restored after 2 minutes.

rules.components: V, S, M (a prayer wheel and holy water)
description: Target heals 4d8 + 15 HP immediately and 1 HP at the start of every turn for 1 hour. Regrows severed limbs in 2 minutes.

spell_resurrection.name: Resurrection
spell_resurrection.diffSummary: Restores life to a creature that has been dead for no longer than a century, closing all mortal wounds and restoring missing body parts.

rules.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no longer than 100 years and that didn’t die of old age.
If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points, neutralizes poisons, cures diseases, and closes mortal wounds and restores missing body parts.
Imposes a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks, reduced by 1 for each long rest.

rules.components: V, S, M (diamond worth 1,000 gp, consumed)
description: Brings a creature dead up to 100 years back to life at full HP, curing poisons, diseases, and regenerating lost body parts.

spell_conjure_celestial.name: Conjure Celestial
spell_conjure_celestial.diffSummary: Summons a celestial being of CR 4 or lower (such as a Couatl) in 2014, redesigned into a radiant burst pillar in 2024.
diffHighlights: 2014: Summons a CR 4 Celestial statblock (or CR 5 with 9th level slot) with 1 minute casting time and Concentration up to 1 hour.
2024: 1 Action, Concentration up to 10 minutes. Conjures a 10-foot-radius cylinder of radiant divine light dealing radiant damage and healing allies.

description: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower (such as a Couatl), which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.
It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it.
rules.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you summon a celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower.

description: You conjure a column of divine light (10-ft radius, 40-ft high). Deals 4d12 Radiant damage on failed Dexterity save (half on success) or heals allies entering the light.
rules.higherLevels: Damage and healing increase by 1d12 per slot level above 7th.

spell_symbol.name: Symbol
spell_symbol.diffSummary: Inscribes a deadly magical glyph triggering one of eight debilitating effects (Death, Discord, Fear, Hopelessness, Insanity, Pain, Sleep, Stunning) in a 60-foot sphere.

rules.components: V, S, M (mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Inscribes a harmful glyph onto a surface or object. When triggered, activates one glyph effect across a 60-foot-radius sphere for 10 minutes (Death deals 10d10 necrotic, Discord causes infighting, Fear frightens, Hopelessness demoralizes, Insanity causes madness, Pain incapacitates, Sleep knocks unconscious, Stunning stuns).

rules.components: V, S, M (diamond and opal dust worth 1,000 gp, consumed)
description: Creates an arcane ward triggering catastrophic area effects (Death, Pain, Stun, Insanity, Discord, Sleep, Fear, or Hopelessness) in a 60-ft radius.

spell_teleport.name: Teleport
spell_teleport.diffSummary: Instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures to any destination you designate on the same plane.

description: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to a destination you select on the same plane.
Instantly transports you and up to 8 willing creatures or 1 object to a known destination on the same plane.

spell_forcecage.name: Forcecage
spell_forcecage.diffSummary: Creates an invisible cube or cage of force trapping creatures without an initial saving throw (requires Concentration and consumes ruby dust in 2024).
diffHighlights: 2014: 1 Action, 1 hour duration (NO CONCENTRATION). 1,500 gp ruby dust NOT consumed. No initial save.
2024: 1 Action, Concentration up to 1 hour. Consumes 1,500 gp ruby dust. Trapped creatures must make Charisma saves to teleport out.

rules.components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500 gp)
description: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range (up to 20-ft cage or 10-ft solid box). No initial save.

rules.components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, consumed by the spell)
description: An invisible cube of force traps creatures without initial save. Requires Concentration and consumes material component.

spell_delayed_blast_fireball.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spell_delayed_blast_fireball.diffSummary: Creates a glowing yellow bead dealing 12d6 fire damage, increasing by 1d6 for every round delayed up to 1 minute (+10d6 max).

rules.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and pitch)
description: A beam of yellow light flashes and coalesces into a glowing bead at a chosen point. Deals 12d6 fire damage in a 20-foot radius when detonated, plus 1d6 fire damage for every full round it was delayed (up to 22d6 total).
rules.higherLevels: Base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7th.

rules.components: V, S, M (bat guano and pitch)
description: Glowing bead deals 12d6 Fire damage in 20-ft radius (+1d6 per turn concentrated) on Dexterity save.
rules.higherLevels: Base damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7th.

spell_finger_of_death.name: Finger of Death
spell_finger_of_death.diffSummary: Sends negative energy through a creature dealing 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on Constitution save; a slain humanoid rises as a permanent Zombie under your command.

description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half on success.
A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie under your permanent control.
Deals 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on failed Constitution save (half on success). A humanoid killed rises as a permanently commanded Zombie.

spell_prismatic_spray.name: Prismatic Spray
spell_prismatic_spray.diffSummary: Unleashes eight multicolored rays in a 60-foot cone dealing 10d6 damage of various types (Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison, Cold) or inflicting Petrification/Planar Banishment.

description: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand in a 60-foot cone. For each target, roll a d8 to determine the ray (1: Red 10d6 Fire, 2: Orange 10d6 Acid, 3: Yellow 10d6 Lightning, 4: Green 10d6 Poison, 5: Blue 10d6 Cold, 6: Indigo Petrified, 7: Violet Banished to another plane, 8: Struck by two rays).
Fires a 60-ft rainbow cone inflicting diverse elemental damage (10d6) or petrification/banishment based on d8 roll.

spell_reverse_gravity.name: Reverse Gravity
spell_reverse_gravity.diffSummary: Reverses gravity in a 50-foot radius, 100-foot high cylinder, causing creatures and objects to fall upward and take falling damage when reversed.

rules.components: V, S, M (a lodestone and iron shavings)
description: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder. All creatures and objects fall upward to the top of the cylinder. If an object/ceiling stops their fall, they suffer impact falling damage. When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall back down.

rules.components: V, S, M (a lodestone and iron shavings)
description: Reverses gravity in a 50-ft radius, 100-ft high cylinder, dropping creatures upward into the air or ceiling.

spell_simulacrum.name: Simulacrum
spell_simulacrum.diffSummary: Creates an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid with half max HP, all statistics, spell slots, and actions.

rules.components: V, S, M (snow or ice in quantities sufficient to made a life-size copy, hair/fingernail clippings, and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range. The duplicate is a creature, partially real, formed from ice or snow.
It has half the creature’s max HP and all statistics and abilities, but cannot regain spell slots or level up.

rules.components: V, S, M (snow, hair clippings, and ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, consumed)
description: Creates an exact magical duplicate of a creature with half its HP that obeys your mental commands.

spell_etherealness.name: Etherealness
spell_etherealness.diffSummary: Steps into the Border Ethereal for up to 8 hours, allowing you to move through solid objects and perceive the Material Plane as ghostly shades.

description: You step into the Border Ethereal. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration, moving through solid objects and creatures on the Material Plane at will.
rules.higherLevels: Slot 8th: Target up to 3 willing creatures. Slot 9th: Target up to 5 willing creatures.

spell_magnificent_mansion.name: Magnificent Mansion
spell_magnificent_mansion.diffSummary: Conjures an extradimensional grand mansion containing up to 50 rooms, 100 spectral servants, and a sumptuous 9-course banquet for up to 100 people for 24 hours.

rules.components: V, S, M (a miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each worth at least 5 gp)
description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its portal appears. The portal is a 5-foot-wide, 10-foot-high door.

You and any creatures you designate can enter the mansion as long as the portal remains open. The place has up to 50 rooms, is clean and warm, and contains 100 near-transparent spectral servants and enough food to serve a nine-course banquet for up to 100 people.

spell_mirage_arcane.name: Mirage Arcane

description: You make terrain in an area up to 1 square mile look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. Open fields can become a swamp, hill, or crevassed wasteland; a pond can become a meadow.

The terrain’s tactile elements are physically real: you can climb illusory trees, walk on illusory bridges, and drown in illusory water. Creatures with truesight see the true terrain superimposed on the illusion.

spell_project_image.name: Project Image
spell_project_image.diffSummary: Creates an illusory copy of yourself at any spot within 500 miles that you have seen before for up to 1 day. See and hear through it and speak with your voice.

rules.components: V, S, M (a small replica of you worth at least 5 gp)
description: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles.

You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were in its space. On your turn as a bonus action, you can switch from using its senses to using your own, or back again. Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion.

spell_sequester.name: Sequester
spell_sequester.diffSummary: Touch a willing creature or object to make it completely invisible, undetectable to divination and scrying, and in suspended animation indefinitely until a specified condition is met. Costly component.

rules.components: V, S, M (a powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object is hidden away, safe from all detection for the duration. Upon casting the spell and touching the target, it becomes invisible and can’t be targeted by divination magic or perceived through scrying sensors.

If the target is a creature, it falls into a state of suspended animation. Time ceases to flow for it, and it doesn’t grow older. You can set a condition for the spell to end (such as a time period or a specific event).

spell_arcane_sword.name: Arcane Sword
spell_arcane_sword.diffSummary: Creates a hovering sword-shaped plane of force: make melee spell attacks on cast and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns dealing 3d10 force damage. Costly component (250 gp platinum sword).

rules.components: V, S, M (a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp)
description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack.

rules.components: V, S, M (a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp)

Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack.

spell_holy_aura.name: Holy Aura
spell_holy_aura.diffSummary: Divine radiance envelops allies within 30 feet, granting advantage on all saving throws, imposing disadvantage on incoming attacks, and blinding fiends/undead on hit.

rules.components: V, S, M (a tiny reliquary worth at least 1,000 gp containing a sacred relic)
description: A holy aura surrounds you in a 30-foot radius. Chosen creatures in the aura shed dim light and have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them.
When a fiend or undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the aura flashes with divine light: the attacker must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends.

rules.components: V, S, M (holy reliquary worth 1,000 gp)
description: Grants Advantage on all saving throws and Disadvantage to enemy attacks within 30 ft. Blinds Fiends/Undead that make melee hits on failed Constitution save.

spell_earthquake.name: Earthquake
spell_earthquake.diffSummary: Creates an intense seismic tremor in a 100-foot radius, tearing fissures, toppling structures, knocking creatures prone, and breaking concentration automatically.

rules.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay)
description: You create a seismic tremor in a 100-foot radius centered on a point within range. The ground becomes difficult terrain, and casters concentrating in the area must make Constitution saving throws to maintain spells.

Each round, creatures on the ground must make a Dexterity save or be knocked prone. Fissures open in the earth, potentially dropping creatures inside (taking 1d10 bludgeoning and being trapped). Structures take 50 bludgeoning damage each round.
Massive 100-ft radius quake knocks targets Prone on Dexterity save, creates fissures, and deals 50 Bludgeoning damage per round to buildings.

spell_control_weather.name: Control Weather
spell_control_weather.diffSummary: Takes control of the weather within a 5-mile radius for up to 8 hours, altering precipitation, temperature, and wind speed stage-by-stage.

rules.components: V, S, M (burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water)
description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You can change precipitation (Clear to Torrential rain), temperature (Unbearable heat to Arctic cold), and wind (Calm to Gale/Storm). Takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for new conditions to take effect.

rules.components: V, S, M (incense, earth, wood, water)
description: Alters precipitation, temperature, and wind across a 5-mile radius for 8 hours.

spell_antimagic_field.name: Antimagic Field
spell_antimagic_field.diffSummary: Creates a 10-foot invisible sphere around you where all magic, spells, summons, and magical properties of items are suppressed.

rules.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings)
description: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. Spells can’t be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and magic items become mundane inside.
10-foot sphere suppresses all spells, magic items, and summon effects.

spell_sunburst.name: Sunburst
spell_sunburst.diffSummary: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a massive 60-foot radius sphere dealing 12d6 radiant damage and blinding targets on failed Constitution save.

rules.components: V, S, M (fire and a piece of sunstone)
description: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature takes 12d6 radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute on failed Constitution save (half damage, not blinded on success). Undead/oozes have disadvantage.
Deals 12d6 Radiant damage and Blinded in a 60-ft radius on failed Constitution save.

spell_dominate_monster.name: Dominate Monster
spell_dominate_monster.diffSummary: Telepathically controls any creature on a failed Wisdom save, commanding it to take specific actions or taking total control of its turns.

description: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration.
While charmed, you have a telepathic link with it and can issue precise commands or take direct control of its actions.
rules.higherLevels: Duration is Concentration, up to 8 hours with a 9th-level slot.

description: Telepathically commands any creature on a failed Wisdom save.
rules.higherLevels: Concentration up to 8 hours at 9th level.

spell_feeblemind.name: Feeblemind
spell_feeblemind.diffSummary: Deals 4d6 psychic damage and shatters the target’s mind (renamed to Befuddle in 2024, setting INT/CHA to 1 and stripping spellcasting/communication for 30 days).
diffHighlights: 2014: Named Feeblemind. Target’s Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. The creature can’t cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate. Repeats save every 30 days.
2024: Renamed Befuddle. Target takes 4d6 Psychic damage and cannot cast spells or take Bonus Actions for 30 days on failed Intelligence save.

rules.components: V, S, M (a handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres)
description: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, dealing 4d6 psychic damage and piercing its intellect. On a failed Intelligence save, the creature’s Intelligence and Charisma become 1, and it can’t cast spells or communicate for at least 30 days.
Renamed Befuddle. Deals 4d6 Psychic damage and prevents spellcasting and language understanding on failed Intelligence save.

spell_maze.name: Maze
spell_maze.diffSummary: Banishes a creature to a labyrinthine demiplane without an initial saving throw; escaping requires a DC 20 Intelligence check as an Action.

description: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze.
The target can use its action to attempt an escape by making a DC 20 Intelligence check (Minotaurs succeed automatically).
Banishes target to an extradimensional maze with no initial save; requires DC 20 Intelligence check to escape.

spell_mind_blank.name: Mind Blank
spell_mind_blank.diffSummary: Grants immunity to psychic damage, divination spells, mind-reading, and the charmed condition for 24 hours without concentration.

description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.
Target gains 24-hour total immunity to Psychic damage, mind reading, divination spying, and the Charmed condition.

spell_power_word_stun.name: Power Word Stun
spell_power_word_stun.diffSummary: Utters a word of power that instantly stuns a creature with 150 Hit Points or fewer (no initial save).

description: You speak a word of power that overwhelms the mind of one creature within range. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. At the end of each of its turns, it makes a Constitution saving throw to end the stun.
Instantly Stuns a target with 150 HP or fewer (repeats Constitution save at the end of each turn).

spell_clone.name: Clone
spell_clone.diffSummary: Grows an inert duplicate of a living creature in a vessel over 120 days that receives the creature’s soul upon death, providing true immortality.

rules.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh, plus a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp)
description: Grows an inert duplicate of a living creature that takes 120 days to mature. When the original creature dies, its soul instantly transfers to the clone if free and willing.

spell_demiplane.name: Demiplane
spell_demiplane.diffSummary: Creates a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that leads to a 30-foot empty cubic extradimensional demiplane (or connects to a previously created demiplane) for 1 hour.

description: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to admit Medium creatures easily. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone.
When the spell ends, the door disappears, and any creatures or objects inside remain trapped there.
Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect the shadowy door to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell.

description: A swirling cloud of smoke shot with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud heavily obscures its area.

spell_animal_shapes.name: Animal Shapes
spell_animal_shapes.diffSummary: Transform up to any number of willing creatures into Large or smaller beasts of CR 4 or lower for up to 24 hours. Can transform them into new beast forms as an Action.

description: A magic mist radiates from you, transforming up to any number of willing creatures you can see within range into beasts. You choose the form of each creature: Large or smaller beast of challenge rating 4 or lower.

spell_antipathy_sympathy.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spell_antipathy_sympathy.diffSummary: Attracts (Sympathy) or repels (Antipathy) a specific kind of intelligent creature from a target object or creature for 10 days on failed Wisdom save.

rules.components: V, S, M (either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for antipathy, or a drop of honey for sympathy)
description: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area within 200 feet.
Antipathy: Causes creatures of the chosen kind to feel an urge to leave the area and avoid the target (frightened on failed Wisdom save).
Sympathy: Causes creatures of the chosen kind to feel an overwhelming urge to approach the target and remain within 60 feet of it.

spell_tsunami.diffSummary: Conjures a wall of water up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick that moves away from you dealing 6d10 bludgeoning damage and dragging creatures along.

description: A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range (up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick).

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Strength saving throw, taking 6d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on success. At the start of each of your turns, the wall moves 50 feet away from you, dragging caught creatures with it and dealing damage.
